  SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
  AND sale_date >= '2025-12-15'

GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

  MAX(sale_date) AS latest_sale,
  COUNT(*) AS total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line

  COUNT(*) AS total_sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  r.return_date,
  SUM(r.refund_net) AS total_refunds,
  COUNT(*) AS return_lines
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line s ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE c.channel_group = 'web'
  AND r.return_date >= '2025-12-15'
  AND r.return_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY r.return_date
ORDER BY r.return_date

SELECT 
  d.calendar_date,
  COALESCE(SUM(sales.net_amount), 0) AS gross_sales_net,
  COALESCE(SUM(returns.refund_net), 0) AS returns_net,
  COALESCE(SUM(sales.net_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(returns.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    f.sale_date,
    f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE c.channel_group = 'web'
) sales ON d.calendar_date = sales.sale_date
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    r.return_date,
    r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line s ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE c.channel_group = 'web'
) returns ON d.calendar_date = returns.return_date
WHERE d.calendar_date >= '2025-12-15'
  AND d.calendar_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY d.calendar_date
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  c.channel_id,
  c.channel_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE f.sale_date = '2025-12-15'
  AND c.channel_group = 'web'
GROUP BY f.sale_date, c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY c.channel_id
